A **brick** is a kind of block made of clay that has been shaped while it is soft and then dried until it is hard. People of this culture drew and wrote on bricks of this kind while the clay was still soft. If your readers would not be familiar with what a brick is, you could use the name of a similar thing that your readers would recognize, or you could use a more general term.
